findings.kind: confirmed next-substage engineering-contract gap; not an implemented product defect
findings.scenario: Implement the proposed source-aware PendingTurnSnapshotReader overload now. The documents name a source/core and later whole-admission closure, but leave the concrete construction, export boundary and default-wrapper behavior unresolved. Existing ReadCurrent returns a PendingTurnSnapshotReadAuthority after physical validation, while the proposed session may still be open and later failed/rechecked. A caller-supplied source could fabricate input provenance if the new seam accepts delegates/maps; an unclosed read result could also be mislabeled as sealed evidence. These are concrete competing implementation choices not fixed by the current API proposal.
findings.requirement: Preserve actual original authority, same filesystem/lease and transitive callback coverage, unchanged ordinary reader behavior, and no caller/imported admission authority. Decide the exact bounded API before writing its tests/implementation.
findings.correction: Add a narrow source-reader contract with private concrete production construction and self-contained capture+recheck before exporting the observed result (root preference), or explicitly separate unclosed original-read data from a mandatory owner-only closed result. Specify all physical operations, decoding/hash modes, error/absence behavior, reentry/lifetime and exact compatibility cases below. No active admission/S/C/B/M3 issuer or all-seven-root validation is implemented by this prerequisite.
findings.blocks: Implementation release for this new observed-reader API only until its exact contract receives affected review; does not reopen prior accepted story/ledger work or require user permission.

nonblockingObservations.note: Qualify all-rehashed observation-forgery controls as independently derivable semantic/source inconsistencies; do not imply universal attestation of irrecoverable observations beyond trusted-local protocol.

requiredNarrowContract: One production-created concrete source captures the actual FileSystemManager and existing live lease; callers select only existing validated logical paths. No caller-provided physical read function, arbitrary map or parsed source DTO can instantiate it.

Factor the existing parse/authentication/selection core without changing default ReadCurrent fs/lease/selection semantics. Define a distinct observed entry/result rather than silently strengthening every old caller or treating observation as admission.

For the preferred self-contained alternative, hold the same caller-owned lease through capture and final recheck, return failure with no successful observed export on any captured fault/drift, and never retain or acquire a second lease. It owns no GM wait.

Use explicit operation roles for manifest text, detached-authority text, owner-validated rollback bytes, the fixed repair/request/Ready existence+text contexts, and selected authenticated snapshot bytes. Dynamic physical backup/snapshot coordinates come only through existing validated manifest/authority rules, not the 73-leaf lexical index as a caller allowlist.

Retain exact raw bytes/presence and existing text decoding/hash modes; record every observed callback. Optional absence, present-empty, malformed content and read failure remain distinct. The maximum selected original-path count does not cap all rollback authority callbacks.

Define failure/result and lifecycle states explicitly. Unsupported read and physical read failure poison only the new observed operation; existing diagnostic conversion remains intact. Closed results are immutable and bound to the actual operation. No source certificate is exported from an open/faulted source.

Keep default original/request/Ready/v2 emitted bytes unchanged. This substage adds no history seed, validator acceptance, clock/freshness authority, active source S, C/B/candidate seal, M3 writer/cold proof, or new durable path.

futureUnrunCases.case: Genuine original producer first, then actual requested originals/control files; observed and ordinary read results have identical bindings, selected bytes, signed absences and ordered diagnostics on the same physical fixture.

Track all manifest/authority reads, every actual registered rollback callback (even backups unrelated to requested selected logical roots), all three context existence/text reads in order, and selected snapshot bytes. No direct scalar read escapes the observed adapter.

Distinguish absent, empty and unreadable. Preserve missing/invalid/diagnostic-only/usable context classifications and repair/request/Ready conflict rules. Signed optional absence differs from uncovered optional data; incomplete or confusable coverage refuses.

Malformed/duplicate/aliased manifest/authority/context, unsafe/case-confusable selected and owner-resolved physical paths, bad hash mode and mismatched exact bytes produce the existing parser/authority outcome; no new permissive fallback.

Inject an actual physical read error at authority rollback callback and other read roles. Preserve ordinary error behavior; observed failure is sticky even when existing authority code converts InvalidOperationException into rollback_backup_unreadable. Never export successful closed evidence from a poisoned source.

Mutate each observed byte/presence family after its read and before final closure; repeated reads that disagree and existence/read races invalidate the observed result. Equal bytes across a recheck remain valid; metadata is not invented as a dependency for a byte-only consumer.

Actual foreign filesystem, foreign/inactive lease and session replacement reject; suppressed ambient context does not trigger another lease acquisition, publication recovery, generation creation, or an arbitrary fallback. Keep session replacement propagation.

Result arrays/records are detached and immutable; no public/importable source constructor, map, time delegate or reflection-issued authority is a production path. One closed source cannot be reused by a foreign read operation or mutated after success/failure.

Preserve text decoding/BOM behavior separately from exact-byte snapshot/rollback hashes; no reserialization. Keep selected-path count/order/64-path limit distinct from the full owner-derived rollback callback inventory.

A genuine full default-reader consumer remains unchanged, including failed and optional-original paths. New observed result proves only this original-read closure; it cannot satisfy whole submitted-output admission, history completeness, S/C/B sealing, take or M3 publication.
